title: PTNK Official Knowledge Atom
description: Canonical schema for promoted official knowledge. Official atoms contain only downstream learning knowledge plus one provenance pointer back to the reviewed candidate.

id.description: Positional identifier in the official knowledge base. It identifies the atom's position and must not encode the lexical item or sense.

definition.description: Source-provided definition preserved verbatim. Do not paraphrase a definition that already exists in the source.

candidate_ref.description: Pointer to the reviewed candidate record from which this official atom was promoted.
